primary_text: "I don't even know how buying off the plan works for commercial property." Fair enough — it's not something you do every day. But it's far less complicated than most people assume. You pick your warehouse, pay a deposit, and the price is locked in while it's being built. You settle when construction finishes. Thousands of businesses across Australia have done it. Our team guides you from enquiry to keys. New Truganina warehouses near Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel. Book a no-obligation walkthrough of the process.
